name: kalastria_highborn_only_your_vampires
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever this creature or another Vampire you control dies, you may pay {B}. If you do, target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.' Seat 0's Bear (not a Vampire) dies, then seat 1's Opp Vampire dies: neither is this creature or a Vampire seat 0 controls, so nothing is offered (an offer would raise here: no step carries a decision) and seat 0's {B} stays in its pool.
